references.text: Eliasaph, son of Lael, was the head of the Gershonite family, showing the same pattern of leaders over the Levitical families.
Elzaphan, son of Uzziel, was the head of the Kohathite family, following the same structure with family heads among the Levites.
The Levites were to camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, which explains why Merari's sons were positioned on the north side.
The camp of Dan was on the north side of the tabernacle, and Merari's sons also camped on the north side, between the tabernacle and the camp of Dan.
The boards of the tabernacle on the north side are mentioned, which Merari's sons were responsible for carrying.
Four carts and eight oxen were given to Merari's sons under Ithamar's supervision, to transport the heavy parts of the tabernacle.
